value.instructions: Use Ad Testing for Unity Ads on iOS/Android. Host the exact index.html at an accessible HTTPS .html URL with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, or use the UA dashboard. Scan its QR code and check gameplay, orientations, background/resume and one deliberate CTA after gameplay. No official preview run is implied by rule review.
